lines.t:
The place where a <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c> is held. There are 10
terrains: <c:ffff00>{{plains}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{forest}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{rocky_ground}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{sand}}<c>,
<c:ffff00>{{tundra}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{hall}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{waterside}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{underwater}}<c>, <c:ffff00>{{sky}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cyber}}<c>.
Depending on the <c:ffff00>{{leg_type}}<c> of the <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c>, there is
a <c:ffff00>{{terrain_affinity}}<c>.

Usually the current location is used, but by mutual
agreement you can move or use a virtual space.
